note: Simplified import-tax rules for a GB buyer. ESTIMATES, not tax advice. Verified 2026-10-31 against the listed sources.

rules.note: Domestic purchase: UK consumer prices already include VAT (standard rate 20%); no import charges.

Consignment intrinsic value <= £135 (excludes shipping and VAT): the seller charges UK VAT (20%) at checkout and no customs duty is due. Above £135: import VAT plus commodity-specific customs duty, paid to the carrier. Assumes US listed prices exclude sales tax on export. The UK plans to remove the £135 duty relief by March 2029 at the latest.

Same UK rules as US-GB. Assumes German consumer prices include 19% German VAT (standard rate; confirmed by multiple secondary sources, not the ministry) and that the retailer removes it on export (zero-rated). Retailer practice varies, so this is an estimate.
